snippet.title: Shapesetter - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Program the machine. Set your shape.

Build a machine of arms that grab, cut, paint, and weld shapes. Program each arm with simple instructions like grab, rotate, and release to create the target artwork. Then optimize: every machine is ranked on cycle count and surface area.

Website: https://shapesetter.com

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840770/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer

All footage captured in-game, not final.
